|game_text=Once per game, may ▲ [[Jawa Blaster]] or a card with "sandcrawler" in title or gametext. Once per turn, if present at a Tatooine battleground and there is more than 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile, you may use 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-rtichweei-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Rtic_Hweei.png]]). The later errata version is [[R'tic H'weei (Virtual Block 8) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Once per game, may ▲ Jawa Blaster or a card with "sandcrawler" in title or gametext. Once per turn, if present at a Tatooine battleground and there is more than 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile, you may use 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-rtichweei-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Rtic_Hweei.png]]) print it. The dedication line “In memory of Eric White, 1983 - 2011” printed under the text box is not game text (see the dedication field). The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 13) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[R'tic H'weei (Virtual Block 8) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) rewrote the text (“take one … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” for the ▲, “If present at a Tatooine battleground, once per turn,” moved first, “Force” → “card”, “you” dropped)<ref name="cl-1281_6-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013 and on the Virtual Master list (VMasterType)</ref>: “Once per game, may take one Jawa Blaster or a card with 'sandcrawler' in title or gametext into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If present at a Tatooine battleground, once per turn, if there is more than 1 card in opponent's Force Pile, may use 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-03-Rtic_Hweei-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
